title: Harden GHL OAuth flow and token compatibility
body: ## Summary - harden `/oauth/gohighlevel/start` to generate docs-compliant OAuth redirects and centralize install flow through backend - enforce callback state validation and improve token exchange resilience across Company/Location OAuth user types - improve runtime token selection and refresh behavior for HL API calls, with compatibility fallbacks for message send endpoints - route frontend “Connect GoHighLevel” links through backend `/oauth/gohighlevel/start` ## New update (this turn) - fix Company-token lookup for subaccount operations when the target `ghlLocationId` is not yet mirrored in `locations` - fallback sequence now is: (1) agency mapping from `locations`, (2) infer company from any OAuth row tied to the target `locationId`, (3) newest Company token on file as last resort - this prevents false "no agency/company token" failures during location sync for newly connected subaccounts ## Validation - `npm run check --workspace @agentflow/api` - `npm run build --workspace @agentflow/api`
